correctness.rationale: On N identical V-type three-level cells, the symmetric q-excitation sector has dimension q+1 and the unused (q−1)-excitation ambient sector has dimension 2^{q−1} binom(N,q−1)−q≥q+1 for all N≥3,q≥2. Choosing isometries onto these unused sectors, fixing q=0,1 and completing a unitary produces an exact compressed-Hamiltonian shift by ω on all q≥2, so the work gain is ω p_{≥2} for every coherent/mixed symmetric-supported state. A ground/q=2 mixed state saturates this coefficient. For N=2, only two unused lower-energy directions exist for the three-dimensional S2; spectral rearrangement proves the 2/3 state-dependent coefficient, saturated by P_sym/6, and the rank-nullity argument excludes a fixed unitary guaranteeing any positive coefficient. Independent integer dimension checks through N=40 and exact P_sym/6 energies confirm essential boundaries.
